en.hook: Home weekly. Class A regional drivers.
en.body: Regional runs with a Class A. You get home weekly, and the freight is no-touch, so your day is driving, not unloading.

es.body: Rutas regionales con licencia Clase A. Llegas a casa cada semana y la carga es no-touch: tu trabajo es manejar, no descargar.

en.hook: No-touch freight for Class A drivers
en.body: You drive, you don't unload. Every load is no-touch freight on regional routes, and you're home weekly. Class A required.

es.hook: Carga no-touch para choferes Clase A
es.body: Tú manejas, no descargas. Toda la carga es no-touch, en rutas regionales, y estás en casa cada semana. Se requiere licencia Clase A.

en.body: Here's the job straight. Regional runs, home weekly, and no-touch freight. If you hold a Class A, call us and we'll walk you through it.
